title: Operational Excellence Director
text:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Responsible for assisting in the effective development, coordination and presentation of training and programs of new innovations and process improvement initiatives.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

Know and uphold ARAMARK's policies, procedures and Service Agreement with GM. Take ownership of campus wide facilities, infrastructure and grounds, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance facility performance, operating effectiveness and cost efficiency.

Areas of Responsibility

* Drive Business Optimization
* Drive Field Rollout of New Innovations including Market Pro
* Lead Beta and Pilot Testing of new Innovations
* Lead program and process improvement initiatives

Common Tasks

* Work with accounts to increase overall optimization of operations
* Research and explore opportunities to increase effective use of labor
* Create measurement tools to ensure account optimization
* Work with Innovation Design to develop field testing protocols of new innovations
* Evaluate effectiveness of new innovations within the field
* Develop rollout plans to ensure effective utilization by all accounts
* Work hands on with the Regions, Districts and accounts to ensure rollout of innovations
* Support the development and delivery of leadership training(s)
* Marketing and training of new innovations based on field experience
* Influencing without Authority
* Coach field users of Sherlok to grow their business and capture organizational insights
* Set development priority for Sherlok tech team

Success Indicators

* Increased field adoption of new technology
* Successful rollout and adoption of new technology and programs by the field
* Clear and Concise reporting of insights and recommendations to Business Unit leadership
* Continuous Advancement of account optimization via adoption of COE Programs

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Must have experience in a manufacturing environment. Automotive manufacturing experience is preferred.
* Superior communication, written, multi-tasking and presentation skills.
* Confident and assertive enough to provide on the spot service training.
* Must be computer literate.
* Must be highly organized and have great attention to detail.
* Ability to deal effectively with all company staff. Proven ability to lead by example and foster mentoring relationships.
* Experience in meeting facilitation desirable.

Adaptability to work in a diverse environment, focus on customer satisfaction under high-stress conditions, and organize an effective response to day-to-day requirements, and one-of-a-kind extremes.
